A path for deeper reading

Focus the next stage of research on: Cherokee-authored removal histories, language and syllabary, and distinct contemporary governments. The sources below are selected reading paths; their authorship, dates and community scope should guide how they are used.

Maps with context

Historical maps

Explore authentic historical documents connected to this entry. Their names and boundaries reflect their makers and periods.

c. 1721 design; LOC reproduction, 1929 · Represented historical people

Catawba deerskin map: archival reproduction

Unidentified Indigenous maker; colonial copy associated with Francis Nicholson

Cherrikies appears in the upper-right circle. Newberry explicitly identifies Cherokee among these represented communities. The link concerns historical representation.

Historical scope: c. 1721 network

Evidence for this connection: Newberry: curator’s notes ↗

Map-room record & credits ↗Original archive ↗

Underlying mapmaker and colonial copyist unnamed. Supplied digital reproduction; exact scan provenance unconfirmed. Historical interpretation: Library of Congress and Newberry Library. Archive reuse and provenance notes ↗

1760 · Named subject of historical map

A new map of the Cherokee Nation

Thomas Kitchin (engraver); unidentified Indigenous draught credited on the sheet

This engraving depicts Cherokee towns and rivers in 1760. Its title identifies the Cherokee Nation, without assigning the map to a single present-day Cherokee government.

Historical scope: 1760

Evidence for this connection: UGA / Digital Library of Georgia: item record ↗

Map-room record & credits ↗Original archive ↗

A new map of the Cherokee Nation, 1760, hmap1760k5, Hargrett Rare Book and Manuscript Library, University of Georgia Libraries; presented by the Digital Library of Georgia. Engraved by Thomas Kitchin. No Copyright — United States ↗

These map connections are a growing selection. Historical depictions do not establish current boundaries, and a link does not imply community authorship or endorsement.
